decisive_items: verrucous, infected ulceration with infiltrated, hyperkeratotic edges
progressively enlarging over the past 18 months
response.rationale: Chronic non-healing verrucous ulcer with infiltrated hyperkeratotic edges and progressive enlargement despite antifungals favors squamous cell carcinoma over keratoacanthoma (which typically grows rapidly) and chronic fungal infection (excluded by treatment failure).

rejected.why: Antifungal treatment failure and progressive ulceration contradict a purely fungal etiology.
Keratoacanthoma usually has rapid growth; 18-month progressive infiltration and ulceration are more consistent with SCC.
